title: From AI Skeptic to Believer in 90 Days
summary: A developer describes shifting from viewing GitHub Copilot as autocomplete to treating it as a junior developer teammate, which unlocked practical value for BC TechDays demo development. The mindset change from tool to teammate, validated by Stanford research, enabled rapid productivity gains and organizational AI adoption.
key_points: Treating AI as a teammate instead of a tool fundamentally changes how you use it and the results you get
Agentic mode in GitHub Copilot enables systematic problem-solving rather than just suggesting code snippets
Delegating work through business context and architectural constraints yields more thoughtful solutions than asking for isolated code pieces
The author built a complete BC TechDays demonstration in 5 days using only prompts and no direct code writing
Organizational transformation requires systematic infrastructure and frameworks beyond individual AI mastery

quotes.text: I stopped treating GitHub Copilot like a tool and started treating it like a junior developer I was delegating work to.
quotes.why_it_matters: This mindset shift is the core insight that transformed the author's AI productivity and became the foundation for organizational adoption.

quotes.text: Outperformers treat AI like a teammate… shifting your orientation from tool to teammate changes everything.
quotes.why_it_matters: Validates the author's discovery with Stanford research, showing methodology matters more than the tool itself for getting transformational results.
